snippet.title: Complete Walktrough - Darkwood by Micro Star (1996)
snippet.description:
This is a complete walkthrough of the game Darkwood published by Micro Star in 1996.

It's an old game from the era of the Macintosh 7.

More information here: https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/mac/926745-darkwood/data
